data.name: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
data.overview: Follow Captain Christopher Pike, Science Officer Spock and Number One in the years before Captain Kirk boarded the U.S.S. Enterprise, as they explore new worlds around the galaxy.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise, under the command of Captain Christopher Pike, confronts increasingly dangerous stakes, explores uncharted territories and encounters new life and civilizations. The crew will also embark on personal journeys that will continue to test their resolve and redefine their destinies. Facing friends and enemies both new and familiar, their adventures will unfold in surprising ways never seen before.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In season three, when we reconnect with the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise, still under the command of Captain Pike, they face the conclusion of season two's harrowing encounter with the Gorn. But new life and civilizations await, including a villain that will test our characters' grit and resolve. An exciting twist on classic Star Trek, season three takes characters both new and beloved to new heights, and dives into thrilling adventures of faith, duty, romance, comedy and mystery, with varying genres never before seen on any other Star Trek.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In the fourth season, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise—led by Captain Christopher Pike—embarks on a series of thrilling and emotional adventures across the stars. As they journey to strange new worlds, they battle inner demons and external threats, encounter colorful new characters, reunite with familiar faces and confront terrifying aliens. Through it all, they strive to embrace a bright, hopeful future.

data.overview:
„Star Trek: Strange New Worlds“ folgt Captain Christopher Pike und seiner Crew auf der USS Enterprise NCC-1701, die neue Welten erkunden und Kontakt zu fremden Spezies aufnehmen. Dabei stehen Abenteuer, diplomatische Missionen und die Sicherung der Föderation im Mittelpunkt. Unterstützt wird Pike von seiner Ersten Offizierin Una Chin-Riley und dem Wissenschafts-Offizier Spock, die gemeinsam zahlreiche Herausforderungen meistern.

Die Serie erzählt klassische, episodische Geschichten im Geist der ursprünglichen Star-Trek-Reihe.

data.name: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
data.overview: Em Star Trek: Strange New Worlds, o capitão Christopher Pike (Anson Mount) lidera a equipe do USS Enterprise pelos confins do universo em aventuras perigosas e intensas. Passando-se antes da trama da série original, Strange New Worlds explora mais profundamente o universo Star Trek antes da chegada do icônico Capitão Kirk (William Shatner). Pike, ainda inexperiente em liderar toda a Enterprise por conta própria, se apoia na ajuda de seus companheiros da nave, em especial Una Chin-Riley (Rebecca Romjin), segunda em comando depois dele. Além disso, ele conta a inteligência ímpar do popular personagem Spock (Ethan Peck), um alienígena meio humano meio vulcano. Os passageiros da USS Enterprise irão se aventurar por lugares inimagináveis e viverão uma jornada intensa pela galáxica, encontrando aliados fiéis, mas também fazendo inúmeros inimigos perigosos pelo caminho. Mas com o apoio de cada um, poderão completar suas missões com sucesso.

El capitán Pike, el oficial científico Spock y Number One exploran nuevos mundos alrededor de la galaxia a bordo de la USS Enterprise.

data.name: Стар Трек: Странни нови светове
data.overview: Капитан Кристофър Пайк се завръща в Звездната флотилия, за да помогне за спасяването на офицер, изчезнал по време на тайна мисия. Така той отново оглавява емблематичния космически кораб Ентърпрайз и, заедно със Спок, Ухура и Номер 1, поема на приключения из галактиката. „Стар Трек: Странни нови светове“ е предистория на оригиналния „Стар Трек“ сериал от 60-те години.

Το Strange New Worlds είναι τεχνικά και spinoff και prequel, spinoff μιας και δείχνει το πλήρωμα του USS Enterprise μετά την εμφάνισή τους στη δεύτερη σεζόν του Star Trek: Discovery, και prequel του Star Trek: The Original Series (δεδομένου ότι η σειρά είναι διαδραματίζεται περίπου μια δεκαετία πριν ο Κερκ αναλάβει τη θέση του καπετάνιου).

La serie segue i viaggi dell'astronave della Flotta Stellare USS Enterprise (NCC-1701), capitanata da Christopher Pike, durante la sua seconda missione quinquennale (2259-2264), ovvero quella che precede la missione quinquennale del capitano James T. Kirk narrata nella serie televisiva Star Trek. La serie prende il via dalla data stellare 1738.12 (2259), un paio d'anni dopo i fatti accaduti nella seconda stagione della serie televisiva Star Trek: Discovery, quando Pike ha capitanato temporaneamente la USS Discovery.

data.overview: „Star Trek: The Original Series“ serialo priešistorė. Veiksmo sūkuryje „Enterprise“ erdvėlaivio įgula, vadovaujama kapitono Kristoferio Paiko.

ယခု Strange New Worlds ဟာ Prime Timeline မှာရှိနေတဲ့ Captain Kirk ရဲ့ ဖခင် Samuel Kirk ရဲ့ အချိန်ကို ရိုက်ပြထားတာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ Star Trek: Discovery ရဲ့ Spin-off ဆိုလည်း ဟုတ်ပါတယ်။ ဒီအချိန်မှာ အင်တာပရိုက်စ်ယာဉ်ကို ဦးစီးနေသူဟာ ကပ္ပတိန် ခရစ်စတိုဖာပိုက်ခ်ပါ။ Star Trek ရဲ့ နာမည်ကျော် ဇာတ်ကောင် မစ္စတာ Spock ဟာလည်း အင်တာပရိုက်စ်ရဲ့ အကြီးတန်းအရာရှိ (နံပါတ်တစ်) တောင် မဖြစ်သေးဘဲ သိပ္ပံဌာနမှူးအနေနဲ့သာ ရှိနေတဲ့ အချိန်ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ Original series မစခင် အချိန်ပေါ့။ USS Discovery ယာဉ်ဟာ သူ့ကိစ္စနဲ့သူ အနာဂတ် နှစ် ၉၀၀ ကို ခုန်ကျော်ရောက်သွားချိန်မှာ သူ ခုန်သွားခဲ့တဲ့ နေရာအနီးက ဂြိုဟ်တစ်လုံးပေါ်က Civilization ဟာ လှမ်းမြင်လိုက်ရပါတယ်။ အဲဒီမှာ ဒီဇာတ်လမ်းကို စတင်ထားပါတယ်။ အင်တာပရိုက်စ်ရဲ့ အထူးတာဝန်က သက်ရှိအသစ်တွေ Civilization အသစ်တွေကို ရှာဖွေဖို့ ဖြစ်တာကြောင့် အဲဒီဂြိုဟ်ကို လာရဖို့ အကြောင်းဖန်လာပါတယ်။ အင်တာပရိုက်စ်ဟာ သူ့ရဲ့ငါးနှစ်တာ အထူးတာဝန်မှာ ဘယ်လို ထူးခြားဆန်းပြားတဲ့ ကမ္ဘာအသစ်တွေ၊ သက်ရှိအသစ်တွေကို ရှာဖွေတွေ့ရှိရမလဲ၊ ဘယ်လို အန္တာရာယ်တွေကနေ ရုန်းထွက်ကြမလဲဆိုတာကို

data.name: Star Trek: Estranhos Mundos Novos
data.overview: Star Trek: Estranhos Mundos Novos acompanha o Capitão Pike, Spock e Number One a bordo da U.S.S. Enterprise em uma viagem otimista pelo espaço inexplorado. Encontros estranhos, pressão moral e um espírito caloroso de equipa moldam uma missão em que cada novo mundo pode pôr à prova os ideais da tripulação.

data.name: Strange New Worlds
data.overview: Serija se navezuje na serijo Discovery. Tisti, ki ste jo gledali veste, da se je takrat marsikaj vrtalo okoli kapitana vesoljske ladje Enteprise Christopherja Pika. Natanko tiste ladje, ki jo bo nekaj zavednih let kasneje prevzel James T. Kirk v originalni seriji Zvezdnih stez in jo popeljal med legende. Kompletna posadka Discoveryja in del Enterpriseve najprej išče izginulega Spoka, da bi se proti koncu sezone spopadli z odpadniško umetno inteligenco. Epilog je znan: ena ladja odsurfa v daljno prihodnost, medtem ko se druga odpravi novim dogodivščinam naproti. A ne za prav dolgo, saj v prvem delu nove serije izvemo, da je Enterprise na popravilu in Pike razdvojen, ali naj se vrne v službo.
